name: bug-scrub-loop
description: Resumable scrub-plan-fix-merge loop for eliminating confirmed P0-P2 defects.

interface.shortDescription: Scrub, plan, merge fixes, and repeat.
interface.longDescription: Runs measured bug scrubs, reviews executable remediation plans, implements and merges confirmed P0-P2 fixes, and repeats against the original scope until a fresh pass is clean.
defaultPrompt: Use $bug-scrub-loop to eliminate confirmed P0-P2 bugs.
Run a dry bug scrub loop and review the proposed fix plan.
